reason: $29.99 is more than I pay for Toplux or Goli and those last longer. I already forget the vitamins on my counter, and I am not sure a magnesium box is where I want to spend an extra $10 this month.
objection: $29.99 for 30 days is more than the gummies I already buy, and I have no proof yet that magnesium would do anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: A price under $20 a box, or a cheap first box I could try without committing, since the sachet in my bag is the part I do like.
